svg.text: pad-ble v1 on a classic ESP32: where everything goes

The devkit's labels are read off the owner's photograph of 2026-09-30, and the column numbers are that photograph's breadboard rows: USB at row 1, the pins in 6 to 20, the pad's three in 11 to 13 on the EN row. Only rows A and J are reachable under it. An ORIGINAL pad's colours; a replica's differ.
BLE: the module's own radio; USB is the CP2102
4 numbered jumpers, and 5 short wires to the rails

Every one of these is read out of the schematic. Red stubs go to the nearest + rail, blue stubs to the nearest - rail, except a stub from the pad, which is drawn in its own lead's colour; they are not numbered because they are all the same instruction.
PAD1_D0, the yellow lead: U1 pin marked D27 (col 11 row A) to R1 col 23 row H
PAD1_D0, the yellow lead: R1 col 23 row H to J1 D0
PAD_CLK, the red lead: U1 pin marked D26 (col 12 row A) to J1 CLK
PAD_LATCH, the orange lead: U1 pin marked D25 (col 13 row A) to J1 OUT0
